*[[pne|pne]]:
**A [[gismu]] that has an indefinite number of places. (And you thought no gismu on the [[gimste|gimste]] had more than five!)

You can also add arbitrarily many subunit places to: '''bunda dekpu fepni gutci kramu minli broda brode brodi brodo brodu'''. I think these six and '''jutsi''' are the only gismu that can have over five places. Anybody know all the [[cmavo|cmavo]] that can take indefinitely many places?

Among cmavo there are '''du co'e mo''', maybe others.
